about_the_game:
You wake up beneath the ice of Antarctica - without a name, without a past, and with a voice in your head. Your first step into a vast underground world awaits.

About this demo
The demo introduces the starting area and the core systems. It is made to collect feedback on mechanics and the feel of the world.

What is included in the demo

  • Estimated playtime: 60-90 min

  • Areas: starting zone Main Cave

  • Mechanics: resource gathering, basic crafting, simple camp building, inventory and quick slots, basic water and food needs

  • Crafting: most starter recipes for this area are available

  • Research Table: 1 research available that unlocks 1 new memory and 1 new craft

  • Narrative: intro monologues and several short world stories

  • NPC: up to 3 key characters to meet

  • Saving: manual saves and autosave

  • Interface languages: English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Polish, Portuguese, Spanish, Ukrainian

  • Controller support: none

Demo limitations

  • Progress from the demo does not carry over to the full game

  • Other caves are not available for exploration

  • Limited mechanics: expanded building, most NPCs and creatures, special tools such as the rope crossbow

  • Other full-version content is partially represented or not available

Why this demo
We are testing pacing, system usability, and the readability of the world's hints. Leave feedback - it will directly influence the full version.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS or newer
  • Processor: 4-core CPU (Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Modern GPU
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics card
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
